verdict.rationale: HubSpot exposes extensive CRUD APIs (contacts, custom objects, workflows, imports, dedup) with OpenAPI specs and versioning, and even an MCP server for CRM read/write, suggesting broad API parity with UI actions. However, many UI-surfaced features (AI-generated reports via Breeze Assistant, prospecting agent, sequences UI, plain-language report builder) are not shown to have direct API equivalents, and probes show no llms.txt/docs.md/openapi.json at the root, indicating some agent-discovery gaps. missing for 10: API coverage confirmation for AI/reporting/sequence features shown only as UI capabilities, independent verification of full UI-API parity, working llms.txt/root OpenAPI discovery endpoints.
